description: The line plot illustrates Pass@8 accuracy across varying generation temperatures, measured on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, with a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," spans from 62.5 to 80.0, also on a linear scale. Three methods are compared: 'On-policy RL' (yellow, triangle markers), 'LUFFY' (red, star markers), and 'SFT' (teal, inverted triangle markers). The 'On-policy RL' line starts at approximately 63.0 at a temperature of 0.1 and steadily increases to about 75.0 at 0.8, then slightly declines to 73.0 at 1.0. The 'LUFFY' line begins at 76.0 at 0.1, rises to a peak of 81.0 at 0.8, and then stabilizes at 80.0 at 1.0. The 'SFT' line starts at 73.0, drops sharply to 68.0 at 0.5, and recovers to 74.0 at 1.0, exhibiting the most variability among the three methods. Overall, LUFFY consistently outperforms the other methods across all temperature settings, with On-policy RL showing the most significant improvement over temperature.
